Messages.Author: Reyda
Messages.Body:
hi !
here is a short question :
Frenzy or Drawing out the beast are played on a minion bearing the "Hand of
conrad". can this minion use potence cards during the combat ? do we assume
the effect of the Hand is continuous, thus cannot be "interrupted" by the
above cards, or do we assume that it triggers when we want to use potence
cards -thus being stopped if a cards prevent the use of equipment ?

reyda

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
>===== Original Message From "Reyda" <re...@noos.fr> =====


Good question.
DotB makes the opposing minion play as if he had no equipment, so he
loses the Potence effect of Hand of Conrad.
I'll put this on the RT list for review.

No problems here, but while you're at it:

If the acting minion burns Vial of Garou Blood before range, then
the non-acting minion uses DotB, does the acting minion still gain
benefits from the Vial? That is, the benefits are provided by an
equipment card's cardtext, but the equipment was already 'used'
(and burned thereby) before DotB was played. Sticky.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Gomi no Sensei wrote:
> If the acting minion burns Vial of Garou Blood before range, then
> the non-acting minion uses DotB, does the acting minion still gain
> benefits from the Vial? That is, the benefits are provided by an
> equipment card's cardtext, but the equipment was already 'used'
> (and burned thereby) before DotB was played. Sticky.

Ah, yes. This one's come up before (and parallels the burning a
Camarilla Vitae Slave case). You use the Vial only in the instant
you burn it to gain some effect. The effect is available to you
later and doesn't count as using equipment later. So if you burn
the Vial before the DOtB is played (since you can't after the DOtB
is played), you get the benefits described for the duration
described even if DOtB is played.


